director.name: 德米特里·达维多夫 Dmitrii Davydov

introduction: In search of happiness and friends, the charming loser Vasya returns from the city to his native village. But the former classmates have matured a long time ago: they have children, work, and everything is according to the rules. What will be his return to carefree youth?The story about 40-year-old Vasily, who has been trying to find for more than 20 years happiness in the city when coming back home to the village, he understands that his already nobody waits and nobody wants it already.http://moscowfilmfestival.ru/miff44/eng/films/?id=44003
